recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Reopen only if FHIR-I wants a separate guaranteed all-references operation, which would be broader than the final FHIR-24888 decision.
issue_request: FHIR-24888 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for an all-references search use case. It originally requested an operation to find resources that reference a target resource for delete and referential-integrity workflows, but the final FHIR-I decision was to define _revinclude=* and _include=* instead, scoped to include/revinclude behavior supported by the server, typically indexed references, and to declare '*' in CapabilityStatement like any other include or revinclude.
initial_application: Git commit 83c723c77c26704fa9fd9afbee5e5e52772c3d1d ("FHIR-24888 First pass") updated source/search.html with wildcard include/revinclude syntax bullets and CapabilityStatement advertising guidance. Current source/search.html retains those rules, and later source history added related clarifications without changing the seed decision.
additional_context: The originating Zulip thread and 2021-02-01 FHIR-I minutes show the work group considered a separate operation versus wildcard search behavior and accepted bounded _revinclude=* plus _include=* semantics by a 20-0-0 vote. FHIR-27861 confirms broad _include=* and _revinclude=* were not standard in R4 before this issue. Later FHIR-33309 and FHIR-46381 clarified wildcard support scope and CapabilityStatement declaration semantics already present in current source.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. The active search page defines [_include|_revinclude]=*, scopes wildcard results to resources and references supported by the server and typically indexed, preserves later support-for-_include/_revinclude clarification, and tells implementers to advertise wildcard support in CapabilityStatement. The active CapabilityStatement StructureDefinition comments state that '*' is an allowed searchInclude/searchRevInclude value and that listing '*' makes no assertions beyond wildcard support.
